dct_description_sm:
Date Created: December 2023
Update Frequency: Monthly
Last Reviewed: October 2024
Accuracy, Completeness, and Known Issues: 
  • Organization/format of the ASE camera speed data was updated to enhance user experience by making it easier to filter and search for information. In addition, rows of not applicable information were removed for ASE cameras on dates that they were not yet installed to clean the dataset and reduce the file size. The updates were completed as of October 8th, 2024.
  • ASE cameras previously listed as installed in 2021, sites E009-E013, have been updated to 2022 in the Camera_Install_Year field as of October 22nd, 2024.
Attributes:
 
  • Monthly per speed camera
  • Average Speed (AvgSpeed)
  • 85th percentile (Pct85th)
  • Compliance percentage (PctCompliance)
  • Percentage of high end speeder (PctHighEndSpeeders)
 
Data Steward: Connor Fowke
Data Steward Email: Connor.Fowke@ottawa.ca
Department or Agency: Traffic Services
Branch/Unit: ASE
